verdict.rationale: OpenRouter is API-first: one programmatic endpoint, an OpenAI-SDK drop-in, a published OpenAPI spec, and programmatic API key creation and rotation make headless, unattended automation the default way to use it. Workspace budgets that block requests automatically add guardrails for unattended runs, and community users report running it in production and in evaluation pipelines. Missing for 10: no first-party CI-specific guide or headless CLI tooling, and no hands-on report of use in a CI pipeline specifically.
